podcast.body: This single is from the album "Year of the Black Rainbow," and it was released during the time that Michael Todd was the bass player for Coheed and Cambria, prior to his legal troubles. "Co-heat and Cambria, with We Are Juggernaut, a single from their 2010 album, Year of the Black Rainbow, back when convicted felon, bass player Michael Todd, was still with the group."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: This song is from the album "Year of the Black Rainbow" and features Michael Todd on bass. It was highlighted in the context of Todd's armed robbery and subsequent departure from the band. "And this is We Are the Joverna."
